entities.summary: Abd al-Razzaq Beg Donboli was an Iranian literary biographer, poet, and historian active during the early Qajar period. He belonged to the Donboli, a Turkic-speaking Kurdish tribe, which played a leading role in the areas of Khoy and Salmas in Azerbaijan, northern Iran.
